name: Bun nem
summary: Fresh noodles with nem chua, grilled fish cake, herbs, peanut, pickled mustard, and coriander. The sauce balances sour, hot, salty, and sweet, and each shop keeps its own.
taste: The article says a proper sauce balances sour, hot, salty, and sweet, and that each shop keeps its own.
howToEat: Eat it as a bowl, with the sauce on the side.
seoTitle: Bun nem — noodles and nem in Quy Nhon
seoDescription: Quy Nhon bún nem is fresh noodles with nem chua, grilled fish cake, herbs, peanut, and pickled mustard, in a sour-hot-salty-sweet sauce.
